findings.location:
…When the Psalmist wrote…

(second paragraph of source.html)
findings.source_quote: When the Psalmist wrote, “Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity” (Psalms 98:8-9).
findings.suggested_fix: Translate Psalmist as ‘গীতিকার’ or ‘কবি’ (preserving theological sense) and preserve the exact English scriptural quotation in parentheses as in the source. For example: “নিশ্চয়ই গীতিকার যখন লেখেছিলেন, “Let the floods clap their hands… (Psalms 98:8-9).”
findings.translation_quote: নিশ্চয়ই পুরাণকার যখন লেখেছিলেন, “Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity” (Psalms 98:8-9), তখন এই উদ্দীপ্ত বছরের সময়টাই ছিল।

findings.source_quote: Millions who never experienced Christ the fountain as described in the Hymn History article in this issue:
findings.suggested_fix: Render the title reference idiomatically and clearly in Bengali while preserving the sense that this is the magazine section/title. Use a readable translation such as “এই সংখ্যায় প্রকাশিত ‘Hymn History’ শিরোনামের নিবন্ধে বর্ণিত ফোয়ারা” or keep the English title in quotes if it is a section name: “...as described in the ‘Hymn History’ article in this issue.”
findings.translation_quote: লক্ষ লক্ষ যারা কখনোই খ্রিস্ট—এই সংস্করণ-ইতিহাস-গীতের নিবন্ধে বর্ণিত ফোয়ারা হিসেবে অভিজ্ঞ হয়নি:

findings.location:
…words of the prophet Isaiah…

(final paragraphs before closing)
findings.source_quote: let us be reminded of the words of the prophet Isaiah, “For as the earth bringeth forth her bud …” (Isaiah 61:11).
findings.suggested_fix: Translate ‘the prophet Isaiah’ correctly and avoid redundant phrasing. For example: “তাহলে চলুন নবী ইশায়ার (Isaiah) এর কথাগুলো স্মরণ করি: “For as the earth bringeth forth her bud …” (Isaiah 61:11).” Preserve the exact English scripture quotation in parentheses as in the source.
findings.translation_quote: তেমন আমরা আমাদের বাগান রোপণ করি এবং গাছগুলোকে ফুলে ফোটতে দেখি, তেমনি নবজাত জীবনের কথা স্মরণ করিয়ে দেয় নববাণী—যেমন নববাণী Isaiah-এর কথায় আছে, “For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations” (Isaiah 61:11)।
